QuestInfo.name: This is Not a Drill
QuestInfo.0: After you reach Level 100, the headmaster strikes up a conversation with you.
QuestInfo.1: The Headmaster urges you to hurry to the #bSchool#k for a perfectly normal #bSpecial Training Emergency Drill#k. He says there's a substitute teacher today... You wonder what is going on with the Resistance. Hurry to the #bUnderground Base#k!
QuestInfo.2: Elex wasn't at the Underground Base... #p2151003# met with you instead. Her expression confirms your suspicion... something has gone wrong.

0.0: Oh goodness... what are we going to do? #h0#! You're here! We're doing an emergency drill to round up all students participating in the Special Training program.\r\n#L0##bAn emergency drill? For what? Did something happen?#l\n#k
0.1: Oh, no, it's just a drill. Nothing to worry about, my dear! But do head over the your classroom as soon as humanly possible. In fact, if you were to leave RIGHT NOW, that would be exquisite. Wink wink, nudge nudge. \r\n#L0##b(The Headmaster seems frantic! Have the Black Wings found out about the Resistance?!)#l\n#k
0.2: Yes, head over the classroom. The sooner the better. Snip snap, get a move on, GO.

yes.0: Your homeroom teacher won't be there. Instead, meet a, uh, substitute teacher in charge of emergency drills. Now head to the #bSchool#k and talk to the teacher. Hurry!

no.0: I know students occasionally lack motivation, but sometimes some things are simply TOO important. Please reconsider immediately!

1.0: #h0#! I've been waiting for you! I'm sure you've realized by now that your job instructor isn't here. He was sent on a mission, but he never checked in!

yes.0: Please, calm down. I understand that you're in shock, but you need to pull yourself together! Talk to me again after you take a deep breath.

npc.0: This is an emergency drill. Look alive! Hurry to the #bSchool#k and find your classroom. The teacher in charge of the emergency drills awaits!
npc.1: #b(Has something happened with the Resistance? I've never seen him so anxious before! I should hurry to the School!)#k
